product: 100 AI Business Prompts for Claude & ChatGPT
author: [Your Business] — [Your Name]
instructions: Copy any prompt and paste it into Claude or ChatGPT. Replace [BRACKETED] placeholders with your specific business information. For best results, provide as much context as possible.

prompts.name: Complete Marketing Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a 90-day marketing strategy for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. My target audience is [AUDIENCE]. My monthly budget is [BUDGET]. My main competitors are [COMPETITORS]. Include specific channels, content ideas, ad spend allocation, and KPIs to track each month.

prompts.name: Social Media Content Calendar
prompts.prompt: Build a 30-day social media content calendar for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. I post on [PLATFORMS]. My brand voice is [TONE]. Include post topics, captions, hashtag sets, and optimal posting times for each platform. Mix educational, promotional, and engagement posts.

prompts.name: Google Business Profile Optimization
prompts.prompt: I run a [BUSINESS_TYPE] at [ADDRESS] in [CITY]. Audit my Google Business Profile strategy. Write me an optimized business description (750 characters), suggest the best primary and secondary categories, and give me a weekly posting schedule with 4 post ideas.

prompts.name: Email Marketing Funnel
prompts.prompt: Design a complete email marketing funnel for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. I need: 1) A lead magnet idea, 2) A 5-email welcome sequence, 3) A monthly newsletter template, 4) A re-engagement sequence for inactive subscribers. My audience is [AUDIENCE] and my goal is [GOAL].

prompts.name: Local SEO Keyword Research
prompts.prompt: Generate a comprehensive keyword list for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Include: high-intent service keywords, location-based keywords, long-tail questions people ask, 'near me' variations, and seasonal keywords. Organize by search intent: informational, navigational, transactional.

prompts.name: Competitor Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the marketing strategy of [COMPETITOR_NAME] ([COMPETITOR_URL]). Evaluate their: website messaging, SEO strategy, social media presence, content approach, and apparent target audience. Then tell me 5 specific ways my [BUSINESS_TYPE] can differentiate and outperform them.

prompts.name: Ad Copy Generator
prompts.prompt: Write 10 Google Ads for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Each ad needs: 3 headline variations (30 chars each), 2 description variations (90 chars each), and relevant extensions. Target keyword: [KEYWORD]. My unique selling points are: [USP_1], [USP_2], [USP_3].

prompts.name: Brand Story
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling brand story for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Here's the raw material: I started because [ORIGIN]. The problem I solve is [PROBLEM]. What makes me different is [DIFFERENTIATOR]. My mission is [MISSION]. Write versions for: website about page, social media bio, and elevator pitch.

prompts.name: Referral Program Design
prompts.prompt: Design a referral program for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. My average customer value is [ACV]. My profit margin is [MARGIN]. Suggest: incentive structure for both referrer and referee, messaging templates, promotion strategy, tracking method, and projected ROI.

prompts.name: Landing Page Copy
prompts.prompt: Write high-converting landing page copy for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]'s [SERVICE/OFFER]. Target audience: [AUDIENCE]. Include: headline + subheadline, hero section, problem-agitation-solution section, 3 key benefits with supporting points, social proof section, FAQ (5 questions), and CTA.

prompts.name: Video Script for Social
prompts.prompt: Write a 60-second video script for [PLATFORM] promoting my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. The hook must grab attention in 3 seconds. Include: opening hook, problem statement, solution reveal, proof point, and CTA. Tone: [TONE]. Goal: [GOAL].

prompts.name: Review Response Templates
prompts.prompt: Create 10 Google review response templates for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]: 3 for 5-star reviews (personalized, grateful), 3 for 4-star reviews (appreciative, addressing minor concerns), 2 for 3-star reviews (professional, solution-oriented), 2 for 1-2 star reviews (empathetic, resolution-focused). Include [BUSINESS_NAME] naturally.

prompts.name: Content Repurposing Plan
prompts.prompt: I have a [CONTENT_TYPE] about [TOPIC]. Show me how to repurpose it into: 5 social media posts, 1 email newsletter, 3 short-form video scripts, 1 infographic outline, and 5 Twitter/X posts. Each piece should stand alone while driving traffic back to the original.

prompts.name: Seasonal Marketing Campaign
prompts.prompt: Plan a [HOLIDAY/SEASON] marketing campaign for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Include: campaign theme, offer/promotion, 2-week content calendar, email sequence (3 emails), social media ad copy, and in-store/on-site promotion ideas. Budget: [BUDGET].

prompts.name: Customer Avatar Builder
prompts.prompt: Help me build a detailed customer avatar for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Ask me 10 questions about my best customers, then create a full avatar profile including: demographics, psychographics, pain points, goals, objections, where they spend time online, and what messaging resonates with them.

prompts.name: Partnership Outreach
prompts.prompt: Write 5 partnership outreach emails for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] to send to complementary businesses in [CITY]. I want to propose [PARTNERSHIP_TYPE]. Include: subject line, personalized opening, value proposition, specific collaboration idea, and clear next step.

prompts.name: Local PR Pitch
prompts.prompt: Write a press release and 3 pitch emails for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]'s [NEWSWORTHY_EVENT]. Target: local [CITY] news outlets and blogs. Include: press release (AP style), short pitch email for editors, longer pitch for feature writers, and social media announcement copy.

prompts.name: Marketing Budget Allocation
prompts.prompt: I have $[BUDGET]/month for marketing my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. My goals are: [GOAL_1] and [GOAL_2]. My current channels are [CHANNELS]. Recommend the optimal budget allocation across channels with expected ROI, timeline to results, and metrics to track for each.

prompts.name: Sales Script
prompts.prompt: Write a phone sales script for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. The call is to [LEAD_SOURCE] who [LEAD_ACTION]. Include: opening (10 seconds), qualifying questions (3-5), value pitch, objection handling for the top 5 objections, and closing. Keep it conversational, not robotic.

prompts.name: Objection Handling Guide
prompts.prompt: List the top 15 sales objections for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] and write a response for each. Common ones include price, timing, competition, trust, and need. For each objection, give: the reframe, a one-liner response, and a detailed response with a bridge to closing.

prompts.name: Follow-Up Sequence
prompts.prompt: Create a 7-touchpoint follow-up sequence for leads who [LEAD_ACTION] but didn't buy from my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Mix: emails, text messages, and phone call scripts. Space them over 21 days. Each touch should add value, not just ask for the sale.

prompts.name: Proposal Template
prompts.prompt: Create a professional proposal template for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Sections: executive summary, understanding of needs, proposed solution, scope of work, timeline, investment (pricing), team/qualifications, case studies, terms, and next steps. Make it persuasive, not just informational.

prompts.name: Upsell Strategy
prompts.prompt: Design an upsell/cross-sell strategy for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. My core services are [SERVICES]. Average order value is [AOV]. Create: a service ladder (good/better/best), 5 upsell scripts for point-of-sale, 3 post-purchase upsell emails, and bundle suggestions.

prompts.name: Cold Outreach Email Series
prompts.prompt: Write a 5-email cold outreach series for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] targeting [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. I help them [VALUE_PROPOSITION]. Each email must be under 100 words. Include: pattern-interrupt subject lines, personalization hooks, clear CTAs, and natural spacing (days between sends).

prompts.name: Discovery Call Questions
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive discovery call question framework for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include 20 questions organized by: situation questions (current state), problem questions (pain points), implication questions (cost of inaction), and need-payoff questions (desired future state).

prompts.name: Sales Presentation Outline
prompts.prompt: Build a 10-minute sales presentation for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] to present to [AUDIENCE]. Structure: hook/attention grabber, problem definition, cost of problem, our approach, proof (case studies), comparison to alternatives, pricing, guarantee, urgency driver, CTA.

prompts.name: Referral Ask Scripts
prompts.prompt: Write 5 different referral-ask scripts for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]: 1) Right after service delivery, 2) In a follow-up email, 3) At a networking event, 4) On a phone check-in, 5) In a text message. Each should feel natural and not salesy.

prompts.name: Win-Back Campaign
prompts.prompt: Create a win-back campaign for past customers of my [BUSINESS_TYPE] who haven't returned in [TIMEFRAME]. Include: 3 emails, 2 text messages, 1 direct mail letter idea, and a special offer. Tone: we miss you, not desperate.

prompts.name: Pricing Page Copy
prompts.prompt: Write pricing page copy for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] with 3 tiers: [TIER_1], [TIER_2], [TIER_3]. For each tier, write: a name, tagline, feature list (highlight differences), price anchoring, and CTA button text. Include FAQ section addressing price objections.

prompts.name: Lead Magnet Ideas
prompts.prompt: Generate 10 lead magnet ideas for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] targeting [AUDIENCE] in [CITY]. For each idea: name, format (PDF, video, quiz, template, etc.), what it teaches/solves, expected conversion rate, and how it connects to our paid services.

prompts.name: Testimonial Request
prompts.prompt: Write 5 different ways to ask customers of my [BUSINESS_TYPE] for a testimonial: email template, text message, in-person script, feedback form that captures testimonial-worthy quotes, and a video testimonial request with guidance on what to say.

prompts.name: Sales Forecast Model
prompts.prompt: Help me build a sales forecast for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current numbers: [MONTHLY_REVENUE], [MONTHLY_LEADS], [CONVERSION_RATE], [AVERAGE_SALE]. I want to grow to [TARGET_REVENUE]. Model out what I need to hit monthly, and suggest 3 lever-pull strategies to get there.

prompts.name: Customer Service Scripts
prompts.prompt: Write customer service response scripts for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] covering 10 common scenarios: late delivery, refund request, service complaint, billing question, scheduling conflict, quality issue, miscommunication, pricing concern, wait time complaint, and general feedback. Each response should de-escalate and retain the customer.

prompts.name: FAQ Creation
prompts.prompt: Generate a comprehensive FAQ page for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Create 25 frequently asked questions organized by category: getting started, pricing, service details, scheduling, policies, and results/expectations. Write clear, concise answers that reduce support tickets and build trust.

prompts.name: Onboarding Welcome Kit
prompts.prompt: Create a customer onboarding welcome kit for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: welcome email, what-to-expect guide, preparation instructions, FAQ specific to first-time customers, team introduction, and 'quick wins' they can experience in their first [TIMEFRAME].

prompts.name: Complaint Resolution Framework
prompts.prompt: Build a complaint resolution framework for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: a step-by-step process for staff, scripts for each escalation level, compensation guidelines (when to offer what), documentation templates, and follow-up procedures to turn unhappy customers into advocates.

prompts.name: Review Request Sequence
prompts.prompt: Create an automated review request sequence for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: the perfect timing to ask (based on our service cycle), 3 email templates, 2 SMS templates, an in-person script, and a 'negative review intercept' — how to catch unhappy customers before they post publicly.

prompts.name: Customer Satisfaction Survey
prompts.prompt: Design a customer satisfaction survey for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: 10 questions (mix of rating scales, multiple choice, and open-ended), logic for routing (happy customers → review request, unhappy → direct feedback to owner), and an analysis framework for the responses.

prompts.name: Cancellation Prevention
prompts.prompt: Write a cancellation prevention playbook for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: save scripts for phone/email/chat, common cancellation reasons with counter-offers for each, a 'pause instead of cancel' option, exit survey questions, and a win-back sequence for those who do cancel.

prompts.name: VIP Customer Program
prompts.prompt: Design a VIP/loyalty program for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. My average customer visits [FREQUENCY] and spends [AVERAGE_SPEND]. Include: tier structure, rewards at each level, communication strategy, exclusivity perks, referral bonuses, and projected impact on retention and lifetime value.

prompts.name: Service Recovery Email
prompts.prompt: Write 5 service recovery email templates for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]: 1) Apology for delay, 2) Apology for quality issue, 3) Apology for miscommunication, 4) Apology for billing error, 5) Apology for staff behavior. Each should acknowledge, take responsibility, offer solution, and include a goodwill gesture.

prompts.name: Chat Response Templates
prompts.prompt: Create 20 live chat/DM response templates for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Cover: greeting, pricing inquiry, availability check, service description, booking confirmation, directions, wait time, reschedule, cancellation, thank you. Each should be under 3 sentences and feel personal, not canned.

prompts.name: Customer Journey Map
prompts.prompt: Map the complete customer journey for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] from awareness to advocacy. For each stage (awareness, consideration, decision, service, post-service, loyalty), identify: customer actions, emotions, touchpoints, pain points, and opportunities to delight. Then suggest 3 improvements for each stage.

prompts.name: Staff Training Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a customer service training guide for new hires at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: our service philosophy, greeting standards, phone etiquette, handling difficult customers, upselling without being pushy, service recovery steps, and 10 role-play scenarios with ideal responses.

prompts.name: SOP Generator
prompts.prompt: Create a standard operating procedure (SOP) for [PROCESS] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: purpose, scope, roles/responsibilities, step-by-step instructions with decision points, quality checkpoints, common issues and solutions, and training notes for new staff.

prompts.name: Scheduling Optimization
prompts.prompt: I run a [BUSINESS_TYPE] with [NUMBER] staff. Our hours are [HOURS]. Peak times are [PEAKS]. Help me create an optimal scheduling strategy that: minimizes labor cost during slow periods, ensures adequate coverage during peaks, accounts for breaks, and includes a template I can use weekly.

prompts.name: Inventory Management
prompts.prompt: Design an inventory management system for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. I carry [NUMBER] SKUs/products. Include: reorder point formulas, par level suggestions, a weekly inventory check template, waste reduction strategies, and vendor management best practices.

prompts.name: Vendor Negotiation
prompts.prompt: Help me negotiate better terms with my vendors for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. I currently spend [AMOUNT] monthly with [VENDOR_TYPE]. Write: a negotiation preparation checklist, 3 email templates for requesting better pricing, scripts for phone negotiations, and a vendor comparison framework.

prompts.name: Daily Operations Checklist
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive daily operations checklist for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: opening procedures, shift change procedures, closing procedures, cleaning/maintenance tasks, customer experience checks, and safety/compliance items. Format as a printable checklist with time estimates.

prompts.name: Business Automation Plan
prompts.prompt: Audit my [BUSINESS_TYPE] operations and identify the top 10 tasks I should automate. For each: describe the current manual process, recommend a specific tool or method, estimate time saved per week, estimate cost of automation, and provide implementation steps. My current tech stack: [TOOLS].

prompts.name: Crisis Management Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a crisis management plan for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Cover: natural disaster, data breach, PR crisis, key employee departure, major equipment failure, health/safety incident, negative viral social media, and supply chain disruption. For each: immediate steps, communication plan, and recovery timeline.

prompts.name: Quality Control System
prompts.prompt: Design a quality control system for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: quality standards definition, inspection/review checkpoints, customer feedback integration, staff accountability measures, corrective action procedures, and monthly quality reporting template.

prompts.name: Meeting Agenda Templates
prompts.prompt: Create 5 meeting agenda templates for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]: 1) Weekly team meeting (30 min), 2) Monthly performance review (45 min), 3) Quarterly planning (2 hours), 4) One-on-one with direct reports (20 min), 5) Annual goal-setting (3 hours). Each with objectives, discussion items, time allocation, and action item tracking.

prompts.name: Capacity Planning
prompts.prompt: Help me plan capacity for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current capacity: [CAPACITY]. Current utilization: [UTILIZATION]%. Growth target: [TARGET]%. Calculate: when I need to hire next, what equipment/space I need, the financial implications, and provide a 12-month capacity roadmap.

prompts.name: Customer Data Organization
prompts.prompt: Design a customer data management system for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. I currently use [CURRENT_TOOLS]. Help me: define what data to collect, create a data collection protocol, design a CRM workflow, set up segmentation rules, and ensure compliance with privacy regulations.

prompts.name: Process Improvement
prompts.prompt: I want to improve the [PROCESS] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current state: [DESCRIPTION]. Pain points: [ISSUES]. Help me: map the current process, identify bottlenecks, redesign for efficiency, estimate improvement metrics, and create an implementation plan with milestones.

prompts.name: Technology Stack Evaluation
prompts.prompt: Evaluate and recommend a technology stack for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current tools: [TOOLS]. Budget: [BUDGET]/month. I need help with: [NEEDS]. For each recommendation: tool name, cost, key features, integration capabilities, learning curve, and why it's better than alternatives.

prompts.name: Lease Negotiation
prompts.prompt: Help me prepare to negotiate my commercial lease for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current terms: [CURRENT_TERMS]. Market rate in [CITY]: [MARKET_RATE]. Give me: negotiation leverage points, key terms to push for, common landlord concessions, a comparison of renewing vs. relocating, and email templates for the negotiation.

prompts.name: Blog Post Generator
prompts.prompt: Write a 1,500-word blog post for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]'s website about [TOPIC]. Target keyword: [KEYWORD]. Include: SEO-optimized title, meta description, H2/H3 structure, internal linking suggestions, and a CTA. Write for [AUDIENCE] in a [TONE] voice. Include local references to [CITY].

prompts.name: Website Copy Audit
prompts.prompt: Audit the website copy for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] at [URL]. Evaluate: headline clarity, value proposition strength, CTA effectiveness, SEO optimization, readability, trust signals, and mobile experience. Give me specific rewrites for the weakest sections and a prioritized improvement list.

prompts.name: Newsletter Template
prompts.prompt: Create a monthly newsletter template for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Sections: personal note from owner, featured service/product, customer spotlight, educational tip, upcoming events/promotions, and CTA. Write the first issue using: [RECENT_NEWS]. Keep it under 500 words.

prompts.name: Case Study Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a detailed case study for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Client: [CLIENT_TYPE]. Problem: [PROBLEM]. Solution: [SOLUTION]. Results: [RESULTS]. Format: situation, challenge, approach, results, client quote. Write both a long version (800 words) and a short version (200 words) for social media.

prompts.name: About Page Copy
prompts.prompt: Write an About page for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]'s website. My story: [ORIGIN_STORY]. Our mission: [MISSION]. Our team: [TEAM_INFO]. Our values: [VALUES]. What makes us different: [DIFFERENTIATORS]. Include: a compelling narrative arc, team section, and values section. Tone: [TONE].

prompts.name: Service Description Writer
prompts.prompt: Write compelling service descriptions for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Services: [LIST_SERVICES]. For each service: write a benefit-focused headline, 150-word description emphasizing outcomes (not features), pricing framework suggestion, and CTA. Target audience: [AUDIENCE].

prompts.name: Instagram Bio Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Write 10 Instagram bio variations for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Each must: be under 150 characters, include a value proposition, have a CTA, include relevant emoji, and convey personality. Current followers: [COUNT]. Goal: [GOAL].

prompts.name: Video Content Ideas
prompts.prompt: Generate 20 short-form video ideas for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] on [PLATFORM]. For each: title, hook (first 3 seconds), outline, CTA, and estimated difficulty to produce. Mix: educational, entertaining, behind-the-scenes, and promotional. Consider trending formats on [PLATFORM].

prompts.name: Email Subject Line Generator
prompts.prompt: Write 50 email subject lines for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Categories: 10 promotional, 10 educational, 10 re-engagement, 10 seasonal, 10 curiosity-driven. Each should be under 50 characters and optimized for open rates. Include A/B test pairings for the top 10.

prompts.name: Google Ads Copy
prompts.prompt: Write Google Ads copy for 5 campaigns for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Campaigns: [CAMPAIGN_TOPICS]. For each: 5 responsive search ad headlines (30 chars), 3 descriptions (90 chars), sitelink extensions, callout extensions, and recommended keywords to target.

prompts.name: Social Proof Collection
prompts.prompt: Create a system for collecting and displaying social proof for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: methods to gather testimonials, review request templates, case study interview questions, social media UGC strategies, and a plan for displaying proof across website, social, and ads.

prompts.name: Content Pillar Strategy
prompts.prompt: Develop a content pillar strategy for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. My audience is [AUDIENCE] and my goal is [GOAL]. Create: 5 content pillars (broad topics), 10 cluster topics for each pillar, suggested content formats for each, a 3-month editorial calendar, and SEO keyword mapping.

prompts.name: LinkedIn Content Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a 30-day LinkedIn content plan for me as the owner of [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Mix: thought leadership, industry insights, personal stories, tips, and engagement posts. Write the first 5 posts in full. Include: posting schedule, hashtag strategy, and engagement tactics.

prompts.name: Podcast Episode Outlines
prompts.prompt: Create 10 podcast episode outlines for a podcast about [TOPIC] by my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. For each: episode title, hook, 5 main talking points with supporting details, guest suggestions (with why), and a CTA. Episodes should build authority in [NICHE] and attract [AUDIENCE].

prompts.name: Website Redesign Brief
prompts.prompt: Write a website redesign creative brief for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current site: [URL]. Include: goals, target audience profiles, competitive sites we admire (suggest 5 in our industry), sitemap recommendation, page-by-page content requirements, design direction, and success metrics.

prompts.name: Ebook Outline
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed outline for a free ebook/guide by my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Topic: [TOPIC]. Target audience: [AUDIENCE]. Goal: lead generation. Include: title options (5), chapter structure (8-10 chapters), key points per chapter, data/stats to include, design notes, and landing page copy for the download page.

prompts.name: Job Description Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling job description for a [POSITION] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Include: attention-grabbing intro (not boring corporate speak), responsibilities, requirements (separate must-have from nice-to-have), what we offer, culture description, and application instructions. Salary: [RANGE].

prompts.name: Interview Questions
prompts.prompt: Create a structured interview guide for hiring a [POSITION] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: 5 behavioral questions, 5 situational questions, 3 culture-fit questions, 2 skill-assessment exercises, a scoring rubric, and red flags to watch for. Total interview time: 45 minutes.

prompts.name: Job Post Distribution
prompts.prompt: I need to hire a [POSITION] for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Budget for job advertising: [BUDGET]. Recommend: the top 10 places to post this job (both free and paid), a social media hiring post, a referral bonus program, and a timeline from posting to hire.

prompts.name: Employee Handbook Sections
prompts.prompt: Write [SECTION] of an employee handbook for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: policies that are legally sound, written in plain language (not legalese), reflect a modern workplace, and include examples where helpful. State: [STATE]. Number of employees: [COUNT].

prompts.name: Onboarding Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for a new [POSITION] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. For each phase: learning objectives, tasks to complete, people to meet, tools to master, check-in schedule, and success metrics. Include a Day 1 agenda and a welcome email template.

prompts.name: Performance Review Framework
prompts.prompt: Build a performance review framework for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: quarterly review template, annual review template, self-assessment questions, rating scales with definitions, goal-setting format (OKR or SMART), compensation discussion guide, and PIP template for underperformers.

prompts.name: Compensation Research
prompts.prompt: Help me determine competitive compensation for a [POSITION] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY]. Consider: cost of living, industry benchmarks, experience level [EXPERIENCE], benefits value, and local market conditions. Recommend: base salary range, bonus structure, and benefits package.

prompts.name: Team Building Activities
prompts.prompt: Suggest 10 team building activities for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] with [NUMBER] employees. Mix: in-office/on-site, off-site, virtual, quick (30 min), and half-day options. For each: description, cost estimate, logistics, and what team skill it develops. Budget: [BUDGET].

prompts.name: Exit Interview Template
prompts.prompt: Create an exit interview template for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: 15 questions that uncover real reasons for leaving, identify management issues, capture process improvement ideas, and assess whether the employee would return. Include analysis framework for spotting patterns across multiple exits.

prompts.name: Employer Brand Content
prompts.prompt: Create employer branding content for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] to attract talent. Include: 'Why work here' page copy, 5 employee spotlight post templates, a 'Day in the life at [BUSINESS_NAME]' video script, Glassdoor response templates, and a careers page structure.

prompts.name: Contractor Agreement Outline
prompts.prompt: Outline a contractor agreement for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] hiring a [CONTRACTOR_TYPE]. Include: scope of work template, payment terms, IP ownership, confidentiality, termination clauses, and deliverable acceptance criteria. Note: this is a starting point — have a lawyer review before using.

prompts.name: Training Program Design
prompts.prompt: Design a training program for [SKILL] at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Duration: [TIMEFRAME]. Participants: [NUMBER]. Include: learning objectives, module breakdown, training methods (hands-on, video, mentoring), assessment/testing, certification criteria, and ongoing reinforcement plan.

prompts.name: Pricing Calculator
prompts.prompt: Help me price my services at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. My costs are: [COST_BREAKDOWN]. Desired profit margin: [MARGIN]%. Market rates in [CITY]: [MARKET_RATES]. Create: a pricing formula, 3 tier options (basic/standard/premium), a competitor price comparison, and a price increase announcement template.

prompts.name: Monthly Financial Review
prompts.prompt: Create a monthly financial review template for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include: revenue analysis, expense breakdown, profit margin calculation, cash flow assessment, comparison to budget, comparison to previous month/year, key financial ratios for my industry, and 3 action items.

prompts.name: Break-Even Analysis
prompts.prompt: Calculate my break-even point for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Fixed costs: [FIXED]. Variable cost per unit/service: [VARIABLE]. Average price per unit/service: [PRICE]. Show: break-even in units and dollars, monthly break-even, and a sensitivity analysis (what if price changes ±10%, costs change ±10%).

prompts.name: Tax Preparation Checklist
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive tax preparation checklist for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] (structure: [LLC/SCORP/SOLE_PROP]). State: [STATE]. Include: all deductible categories relevant to my business type, documentation needed for each, quarterly estimated tax reminders, and common deductions my industry often misses.

prompts.name: Cash Flow Forecast
prompts.prompt: Build a 12-month cash flow forecast for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current monthly revenue: [REVENUE]. Monthly expenses: [EXPENSES]. Seasonal patterns: [PATTERNS]. Upcoming investments: [INVESTMENTS]. Include: monthly projections, worst-case scenario, and recommendations for maintaining healthy cash flow.

prompts.name: Business Loan Preparation
prompts.prompt: Help me prepare a business loan application for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Loan purpose: [PURPOSE]. Amount needed: [AMOUNT]. Include: a business plan summary, financial projections template, list of documents I need to gather, lender comparison criteria, and a pitch script for the banker meeting.

prompts.name: Expense Reduction Audit
prompts.prompt: Audit my expenses for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] and find savings. Current monthly expenses: [EXPENSE_LIST]. Help me: categorize each expense as essential/reducible/eliminable, identify renegotiation opportunities, suggest cheaper alternatives, calculate potential savings, and prioritize which to tackle first.

prompts.name: Revenue Diversification
prompts.prompt: Suggest 10 ways to diversify revenue for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current revenue streams: [CURRENT_STREAMS]. For each new idea: description, estimated startup cost, time to revenue, revenue potential, effort level, and how it complements my existing business.

prompts.name: Financial KPI Dashboard
prompts.prompt: Design a financial KPI dashboard for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Include the 15 most important metrics I should track: definition, formula, target range for my industry, frequency of measurement, and data source. Group by: profitability, liquidity, efficiency, and growth.

prompts.name: Price Increase Communication
prompts.prompt: Help me implement a price increase for my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current prices: [CURRENT]. New prices: [NEW]. Reason: [REASON]. Write: announcement email to existing customers, updated pricing page copy, FAQ for staff to handle objections, social media post, and a grandfather clause strategy for loyal customers.

prompts.name: Profit Margin Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Analyze my profit margins at my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Revenue: [REVENUE]. COGS: [COGS]. Operating expenses: [OPEX]. For each service/product I offer: calculate individual margin, identify the most and least profitable, suggest pricing or cost adjustments, and model the impact of a 5% improvement in each area.

prompts.name: Business Valuation Estimate
prompts.prompt: Help me estimate the value of my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Annual revenue: [REVENUE]. Annual profit: [PROFIT]. Years in business: [YEARS]. Assets: [ASSETS]. Show: multiple valuation methods (revenue multiple, earnings multiple, asset-based), comparable business sales in my industry, and what I can do to increase valuation.

prompts.name: Insurance Coverage Review
prompts.prompt: Review the insurance needs for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [STATE]. Current coverage: [CURRENT]. Employees: [NUMBER]. Help me: identify all insurance types I need, recommended coverage levels, estimate annual costs, compare getting individual policies vs. a business owner's policy, and questions to ask agents.

prompts.name: Retirement/Exit Planning
prompts.prompt: Help me plan for eventual exit from my [BUSINESS_TYPE]. Current value: approximately [VALUE]. Desired timeline: [YEARS] years. Options I'm considering: [OPTIONS]. For each exit path (sell, merge, family succession, management buyout, close): requirements, timeline, tax implications, and steps to maximize value starting now.
